channels.description:
The Land of Israel Network, founded by Ari Abramowitz and Jeremy Gimpel, is a global media platform broadcasting from the hills of Judea. From the heart of the Holy Land, we share the beauty, truth, and faith of Israel with the world. Rooted in authentic Torah values, we strengthen the bond between the Jewish people, the Land of Israel, and all who stand with us through podcasts, video teachings, live fellowships, and immersive experiences.

Our hosts are farmers, soldiers, educators, and spiritual pioneers who live the story of Israel every day, offering unfiltered voices from the frontlines of prophecy, destiny, and redemption. Whether you’re watching from across the globe or walking with us here in Judea, this is your home for Torah, truth, and the rising spirit of redemption.

👉 Subscribe now and be part of the story of the Land of Israel.
